جَثَآءٌ i. q. شَخْصٌ [app. as meaning A person; or the body of a man, like جُثْوَةٌ and جُثَّةٌ]; as also ↓ جُثَآءٌ . (Sgh, K.) ―
-b2- [And hence, perhaps,] Incubus, or nightmare. (TA. [But in this sense it is written in the TA جثا, without ء, and without any syll. sign.]) ＝
-A2- Also i. q. جَزَآءٌ [Requital, or compensation]. (K.) ―
-b2- And Quantity, measure, size, bulk, or extent; and amount, sum, or number, (K, TA,) as, for instance, of a people, or company of men. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
